integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically and accompanied by an exact Q(sqrt(2)) checker; literature searches are supporting evidence rather than a proof of global novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the real regular octagonal plane and the unit-sphere parameterized constant; no claim is made for the unrestricted C_alpha constant or other polygon families.
title: Exact parameterized von Neumann–Jordan profile of the regular octagonal plane
